fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: Dashboard chat alias (Validate). Required by the form. Jev models are not chat models — use any alias that passes Validate (e.g. jev-latest). For engine=http the API model is model_alpha.

fields.name: model_alpha
fields.label: Systemone model
fields.description: Model id for engine=http. jev-latest → POST /v1/systemone; jev-trained → POST /v1/systemone-custom. Other ids (e.g. xor-1.2) use /v1/systemone.

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Server origin. Trailing /v1 or /v1/systemone is stripped. engine=http: systemone origin. engine=grid: /v1 is appended for chat completions.

fields.name: engine
fields.label: Engine
fields.description: http: systemone API (default). jev-trained uses /v1/systemone-custom. grid: chat completions. random: pipeline check.

fields.name: task_range
fields.label: Task range
fields.description: Inclusive row indices. Use 0-9 for the first dashboard smoke (Runbook A §14.1). Leave empty for the full suite (~150k rows).

fields.name: delay_s
fields.label: Delay between requests (seconds)
fields.description: Rate limit sleep between API calls (default 0.5s ≈ 120 RPM).

fields.name: resume
fields.label: Resume
fields.description: Keep partial results.jsonl in the run directory. Use false for the first smoke run.
